How Taiwan Is Turning Tech Supremacy Into a Security Shield

The southern Taiwanese city of Chiayi has long been synonymous with a cherished culinary staple: turkey rice, served drenched in savory soy broth and topped with lard-fried shallots and pickled radish. Introduced by American GIs after World War II, the non-native bird became an affordable alternative to chicken and quickly became a local icon. Eight decades later, Chiayi is anchoring its identity in a very different military legacy: uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs).…
